text: All 5 analysed contemporary picture books run 12 spreads with 136-211 words in total (median 150), about 13 words per spread. Evidence: 5 of 5 works, small sample, confidence LOW. Proposal for `validator.BANDS`: Similar total length, but these books spend it on ~12 page turns of ~10-20 words. Worth testing shorter pages and more turns once the corpus is larger.
